t: The Amnesiac Genie's Playbook: Forging a Master Prompt for Resilient AI Agents
s: This article details a methodology for creating robust AI agent workflows by treating stateless AIs as 'amnesiac genies'. It introduces a Master Prompt Template and five core principles: embracing amnesia, defining environmental physics, mandating verifiable toolchains, implementing failure-capture protocols, and defining 'done' as a verifiable state.
sub: Master Prompt Template for agentic AI workflows
Five core principles for resilient AI agent design
Iterative refinement and failure capture in AI prompting
Environment physics and toolchain mandates for AI
Verifiable 'Definition of Done' for AI tasks
